description: A truth table with 4 inputs, giving a chosen result for every combination of their states

params.text: Forces the result true while pressed, so Q carries 10V and the negated output carries 0V
Chooses the condition on the gate that makes the gate column true: the gate rises, falls, either rises or falls, is high, or is low. Rise, fall and edge each last a single sample
Sets that input high while pressed
Chooses the result for that row of the table: T emits 10V, F emits 0V, Q leaves the output as it is, and the fourth setting toggles the output
Forces the result false while pressed, so Q carries 0V and the negated output carries 10V

inputs.text: One of the table's inputs; a voltage above 1V counts as high, despite the manual giving the threshold as 0.5V
The gate input for the table; the gate condition button chooses which condition on it makes the gate column true, and a voltage above 1V counts as high, where the manual says 0.5V

outputs.text: Carries 10V while the table's result is true and 0V while it is false
Carries the negation of the Q output: 0V while the result is true and 10V while it is false

notes: the toggling result flips the output on every sample its row is selected, so it is worth using only on rows reached through a rise, fall or edge condition
the module is mono: it reads the first channel of a polyphonic cable and ignores the rest, and every output carries a single channel
menu: Preset — Rack's own submenu on the module menu, carrying the factory presets shipped with this module: D Flip-Flop with SR
